title: DataRecycle: Trustworthy Distillation of Structured Data from Scattered Web Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2611.29206v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The web contains vast amounts of scattered quantitative evidence that is difficult to organize into comparable and verifiable structures. Yet its unstructured, sparse, and sometimes conflicting nature makes a systematic distillation costly and error-prone. Existing approaches force users to make a trade-off: search engines return document lists that require labor-intensive extraction and reconciliation, while generative AI systems produce fluent summaries that obscure data provenance, introduce reporting bias, and hide inconsistencies. We present DataRecycle, an interactive system that helps transform scattered web evidence into structured tables of comparable numerical facts. Given a user's query or statement, DataRecycle decomposes it into entities and attributes, retrieves candidate evidence, and organizes scattered, potentially conflicting records in a table-based evidence view. translated_title: DataRecycle：从零散网络证据中可信地蒸馏结构化数据
translated_abstract: 网络中包含大量零散的量化证据，这些证据难以被组织成可比较、可验证的结构。然而，其非结构化、稀疏且有时相互矛盾的特性，使得系统性的信息蒸馏成本高昂且容易出错。现有方法迫使用户在两者之间进行权衡：搜索引擎返回的文档列表需要耗费大量人力进行提取与核对，而生成式AI系统产生的流畅摘要则会掩盖数据来源、引入报告偏差并隐藏不一致之处。我们提出了DataRecycle，这是一个交互式系统，能够帮助将零散的网络证据转化为包含可比较数值事实的结构化表格。给定用户的查询或陈述，DataRecycle会将其分解为实体和属性，检索候选证据，并在基于表格的证据视图中组织零散且可能相互矛盾的记录。为解决自动化数据蒸馏中的关键挑战……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: DataRecycle是一个交互式系统，通过将用户查询分解为实体与属性并组织候选证据，把网络上零散且可能矛盾的信息可信地转化为可比较、可追溯的结构化数值事实表格。
en_tdlr: DataRecycle is an interactive system that trustworthily distills scattered, potentially conflicting web evidence into structured tables of comparable, traceable numerical facts by decomposing queries into entities and attributes.
